title: Atomic Heart
description: Atomic Heart is a visually stunning first-person action RPG set in an alternate-history Soviet Union where advanced robotics and artificial intelligence have transformed society. Combining fast-paced combat, immersive exploration, and striking retro-futuristic art direction, the game delivers a technically demanding PC experience. The gameplay showcased on SPCBM is captured entirely in real-time using the 'Atomic' graphics preset, highlighting exceptional image quality, fluid gameplay, and the capabilities of modern high-end PC hardware.
benchmarkNotes: Captured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti
Performance verified through extended gameplay sessions
